name: @vip/messaging
description: The event backbone client (Phase 1, P1-5): a thin, fail-closed wrapper over NATS JetStream (ADR-0016). Provides tenant-partitioned subjects `t.{tenantId}.…` with structural validation, an `EventBus` port (durable publish + pull-consume with ack/nak/term→DLQ), an in-memory bus for tests/local, and a `JetStreamEventPublisher` that backs each service's domain-event seam. Pure-JS `@nats-io` v3 client (no native addon). See docs/architecture/09-EVENT-PLATFORM.md, docs/architecture/phase1/EVENT_PIPELINE.md.
